title: Single Command activation
purpose: Cover the canonical control-direction single-command parser path with an explicit information object address and command qualifier.
expected_behavior: The peer parses TypeID 45 as a single command with activation cause 6 at common address 1 and information object address 1; the final qualifier requests the ON state without select semantics.
constraints_preserved: The I-format APCI length 0x0e equals four control bytes plus the 10-byte ASDU.
TypeID 45 is C_SC_NA_1 according to the supplied function reference.
VSQ is 1 for one information object.
The ASDU contains cause 6, common address 1, IOA 1, and a one-byte single-command qualifier.
The control sequence fields are zero-valued and structurally consistent for an initial client transmission.
issue_safety_notes: PK-only valid command analogue with conservative ordinary addresses and qualifier values; it does not reproduce any historical issue payload.
